headline: Buffby
title: Buffby | Honey Bruiser Evolution | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Buffby is a stage three Wind Aniimo that evolves from Puffby at level sixty two with a Hearty Honeybrew. Bee-Powered Tackle costs ten energy for power twenty five. Majestic Stance costs twenty energy and recharges in fifteen seconds. Its ultimate Super Mega Spin-Bee has power one hundred and fifty. Homeland work is Wind level three. Pick your branch before you spend the item. Buffby or Royalby, which one wins? Comment below!
description: Buffby guide: stage 3 Wind Aniimo from Puffby (Lv. 62, Hearty Honeybrew). Bee-Powered Tackle, Majestic Stance, the Super Mega Spin-Bee ultimate (power 150) and Wind Homeland work. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
joke: Buffby is gentle at heart, but it throws boulders anyway.
